fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-03-22 around 06:20 hrs, it was reported that the complainant lost a gold chain of about 6 sovereigns to a person who grabbed it near Kadal Nagar Bus Stand Area in Coimbatore and ran. The complaint was lodged by Rajeshwari Ammal (9000000242). The complaint mentions Arun Babu, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000379, in connection with the events. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00307, as the mobile number 9000000379 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect reportedly grabbed the chain and fled the spot quickly.
fields.Keywords: chain snatching, gold chain, CCTV, suspect, bus stand, mobile number, early morning
